userRequest: 固定同一批 WTHOR 局面，只切换首条硬标签和聚合软标签
architecture: Frozen v1.37 symmetry-sharing original structure, no direct MLP
rows: Exact frozen v1.42 WTHOR-only 1054132 canonical rows, identical order; no Elo filtering/weighting
hard: Choose first WTHOR occurrence in immutable v1.40 occurrence-file order; its outcome gives hard value and one-hot W/L/D, its canonical aligned smallest stabilizer-equivalent square gives one-hot policy. No majority vote or random choice.
soft: Reuse exact empirical value mean, W/L/D distribution and sparse policy probabilities from immutable v1.42 training-data.npz
controls: Same model factory, full initial parameter hash, boards/turns/phase/legal masks, AdamW/loss implementation, all 15 epochs, seed/order/augmentation hashes. Reinitialize RNG and optimizer for each branch. Only target arrays switch.
selection: Each minimum original frozen validation MSE; freeze both models before testing either. Epoch15 validation shown for equal optimizer-step comparison.
holdouts: Original 6000 validation and 6000 test boards/turns/results/policy unchanged. No new 2s match.
softReplayCheck: Compare fresh soft run checkpoint bytes and all epoch metrics against original v1.42; report equality or numerical differences as a reproducibility diagnostic, not a selection criterion.
limits: Single-seed offline ablation, no Elo or strength claim; first-record ordering is explicitly defined and does not claim to recreate every historical v1.37 label-selection detail.
